inspections.finding: The complete vav shaft joins a broad flat basal platform. Its shallow bar-like outline does not isolate an independent vowel from terminal thickening or a compressed merged stamp. Detached bar, pair, stem and single-node classes, the full vav under-sheva and ordinary vav footer leave the point class unresolved. Retain without claiming point absence.

The complete vav descends through a short side spur into a broad shallow base. Native nesting confirms the joined shaft and lower ink. The small lower irregularities do not preserve a diagnostic horizontal pair, separate bar, deep stem or two comparable stacked nodes. Literal competing vowel classes and the ordinary vav foot remain insufficient to assign one vowel; retain.

The complete initial vav terminates in one broad joined basal platform beneath a thickened lower shaft. A shallow plateau alone does not distinguish a fused bar from terminal ink or a collapsed competing stamp. The literal bar, pair, single-node, stem, vertical-sheva and ordinary-foot comparisons do not uniquely classify it. Retain while refreshing its anchor for the independently accepted yod point only.

The complete yod has an additional lower-left lobe below a recession in the head beside a narrower continuing right tail. The source-detached BEL36 point occupies that lower-left position, and the paired BEL15 pointed yod has the same added branch while its plain yod has only the tail. This comparison supports the additional dagesh without a white-window or expected-wording inference. Append BC after the already present vowel in the existing scalar order.

The complete resh ends in a filled broad lower diamond with a short tapered continuation. The same-unit resh qamats has a distinct crossbar and deeper stem, and resh sheva preserves two comparable vertically rounded nodes. The literal lamed segol has two upper lobes and a lower third node; the plain resh has a small terminal. The target does not preserve a diagnostic arrangement that distinguishes a fused multi-dot stamp from a shortened bar-and-stem mark or terminal mass. Retain without inferring segol from the word or declaring point absence.
